class MayThrowBeforeAssignment {
  value;
  constructor() {
    try { this.value = 1; throw 0; }
    finally { return; }
  }
}
new MayThrowBeforeAssignment().value.toFixed();
class NestedMayThrowBeforeAssignment {
  value;
  constructor() {
    try {
      try { throw 0; }
      finally { this.value = 1; }
    } finally { return; }
  }
}
new NestedMayThrowBeforeAssignment().value.toFixed();
